handoff.text:
Manual downmerge needed: hotfix/1.4.1 → develop

The merge conflicts, so nothing was created. Conflicted files:
  - VERSION
  - app/models/seat.rb

Steps:
  1. Cut hotfix-1.4.1-into-develop-<unix-timestamp> off origin/develop and merge origin/hotfix/1.4.1 into it.
  2. Resolve the conflicts in VERSION, app/models/seat.rb. Keep develop's VERSION.
  3. Push hotfix-1.4.1-into-develop-<unix-timestamp> and open a pull request into develop titled "Hotfix 1.4.1 to develop", listing each resolved file with a one-line reason.
  4. Close the draft hotfix/1.4.1 → develop pull request, if one is open, with a comment linking the new one.

The full procedure is docs/manual-downmerge.md in the versioner repository (https://github.com/officespacesoftware/versioner/blob/master/docs/manual-downmerge.md).
